services.name: Bringing Firearms Into Canada
services.desc: Here is some basic information about bringing a firearm, or other items regulated by the Firearms Act, into Canada. The Firearms Act is a federal law and therefore applies across the country.Provinces and territories may have additional requirements, especially with respect to hunting. An individual must be at least 18 years old to bring a firearm into Canada. Those younger than 18 may use a firearm in certain circumstances, but an adult must remain present and responsible for the firearm.
